split_rule.seed_method: sha256 over the source_sha256 of the members in member order (minerals, opinions, reports), one a line with LF
split_rule.rule: in each kind, the 5 ids with the lowest sha256(seed LF id) in hex are calibration; the others are heldout

reader_text.code_digest_method: sha256 over sorted src/groundgate/read/*.py lines "name NUL sha256(file) LF"
